title: Regenerate provably-wrong SOS/confessions vectors (a6qg gap 7)
description: Fix generator bugs in test/vectors so pins match RFC 8949 canonical order and correct arithmetic, regenerating via the committed generators: (7a) sos_signature.json canonical_cbor_key_order pins [lat,lon,ts,node,type] and canonical_cbor_medical pins [msg,ts,...]; RFC 8949 s4.2.1 length-first order is ts-first ([ts,lat,lon,...]/[ts,msg,...]); cancel vector is correct. (7b) hourly_window_slides pins sos_in_window=0 at now=3600.001s (history 0/1000/2000ms) and post_after_hour_window_slides pins posts_in_window=0 at now=3601s (history 0/300/600s); strict '>' pruning retains entries younger than 3600s so real count is 2 in both. (7c) confessions_rate.json pins retry_after_s=15/=20 exactly; ConfessionsResource returns int(remaining)+1 (=16/=21), a deliberate anti-truncation ceiling — fix vectors to 16/21. After regen, flip the x2 xfail(strict) pins per item in python/tests/coap/test_security_app_vector_consumers.py. Cross-check other implementations consume the same vectors.
